svg.title: A Semaphore with 3 permits lets 10 threads through three at a time
svg.desc: Ten threads each hold a connection for 50 ms. Green bars are time holding a connection, dashed lines are time blocked in acquire. At most three bars overlap; the last thread starts at 150 ms and the run ends at about 200 ms.
svg.text: pool of 3 connections, 10 threads, each holds one for 50 ms
